chapter_note: Chapter 82 is severely damaged (95.6% damage ratio) and dominated by hortatory/ecclesial material on reproof and judgment of brothers in community. The chapter frames a dialogue between a disciple and the Apostle on how to reprove a sinning brother — squarely hortatory application addressing community discipline, with comparison to a wise physician applying medicine. A short cosmological window opens around segs 95–102: a teaching about the 'two faces' of the powers of heaven (love/agape and fear/strife) — this is genuine correspondential material, mapping cosmic powers to faces/aspects within the system. Substrate is NOT dominant here. The bulk is dialogue frame plus hortatory teaching about reproof practice.
